answer: Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The crystal panel is drawn blind, the kernel escrow settles at close, and gale lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 15% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 432 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
